workspace_id_representation: SHA256 references; private exact stable-ID resolver retained outside Git
count_semantics: Owner counts are mapping groups, including one MISSING_OWNER sentinel, not number of authenticated people. Orphan workspace means missing owner; plan/resource orphan means missing workspace. Dangling ownership references are separately counted.

entries.mapping_basis: Existing explicit local ownership FK and local-user existence; zero canonical memberships. No username/email/display matching.

duplicate_policy: Not merged or automatically imported; PRIMARY is the explicitly scoped evidence set.
